description: Upload whole screenshot sets across many localizations in one call. Finds each localization's set for the display type (creating it when absent) and clears it first, so a store-wide screenshot refresh is one call instead of locales x (lookup + clear + N uploads). Use this for any multi-image or multi-locale upload; asc_upload_screenshot is for adding a single image to a known set.

displayType.description: Device size the set belongs to (e.g. APP_IPHONE_67)

filePaths.description: Absolute paths to PNG/JPEG files, in display order

replace.description: Clear each set before uploading so the result is exactly the given list (default: true)

name: asc_upload_screenshots_batch
